note: MyDesk Infra provides conceptual infrastructure planning, DEM terrain interpolation, component roads, bridges, and city model generation targeting Autodesk InfraWorks.

capabilities.name: Digital Elevation Model (DEM) terrain interpolation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Import gridded digital elevation models with bilinear surface interpolation across projected coordinates.
capabilities.expected_input: DEM grid and sample query coordinates
capabilities.expected_output: Continuous ground elevation at arbitrary easting/northing
capabilities.differences: Bilinear elevation interpolation across gridded raster cells.

capabilities.name: Parametric component roads and centerline geometry
capabilities.reference_behavior: Design component roads with multi-lane cross sections, design speeds, and stations.
capabilities.expected_input: 3D centerline vertices, lane width, and speed
capabilities.expected_output: Evaluated road length and alignment geometry
capabilities.differences: Component road length and centerline stations verified.

capabilities.name: Parametric bridge structures and piers
capabilities.reference_behavior: Place bridge spans across terrain depressions with pier placement along road alignments.
capabilities.expected_input: Road reference, start/end stations, pier count

capabilities.name: 3D draped city buildings and usage zoning
capabilities.reference_behavior: Extrude 3D building polygons draped on terrain with functional occupancy categories.
capabilities.expected_input: Footprint boundary polygon, height, and usage
capabilities.expected_output: 3D urban building draped at ground elevation

capabilities.name: GeoJSON spatial feature collection interchange
capabilities.reference_behavior: Export infrastructure roads and polygons to standard GeoJSON FeatureCollection.
capabilities.differences: GeoJSON LineString and Polygon features verified.

capabilities.name: Native project serialization and round-trip
capabilities.reference_behavior: Save and reopen .myinfra native documents preserving DEM, roads, and metadata.
